narrative: The almanac is open on the week. Under this morning, one short line. The rest of the leaf is not a count of days, and no place is written beside the line. He has not added a figure, a house, or a second line. The pen is off the leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the two words and left the rest of the leaf.

entities.name: the almanac
entities.context: Shown on almanac in Term ends
